INSTRUMENT_INFO: FIMS inlet switched between Isok and CVI. Info about inlet configuration can be found in CVI_G1_160501hhmmss_R4_HISCALE_001s.ict. 
DATA_INFO: Units of n_Dp_# are number density (#/cm^3). Geometric mean particle diameters (in nm) of size bins 1-30 can be found in HISCALE_FIMS_bins_R1.dat (col#2) Bin width dlnDp of each size bin is 0.1272. Upper and lower size bin margins (in nm) can be found in file HISCALE_FIMS_bins_R1.dat (col#3 and col#1, respectively). FIMS data are corrected for penetration losses along CVI/IsoK inlet lines.
UNCERTAINTY: Total particle concentration 10%. For additional information contact PI.
